title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF CAPIZ TO APPROPRIATE THE SUM OF NINETY-FOUR DOLLARS AND NINETY CENTS, LOCAL CURRENCY, TO REINBURSE GOVERNOR JUGO VIDAL FOR EXPENSES INCURRED BY HIM WHILE TRAVELING ON OFFICIAL BUSINESS.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF CAPIZ TO APPROPRIATE THE SUM OF NINETY-FOUR DOLLARS AND NINETY CENTS, LOCAL CURRENCY, TO REINBURSE GOVERNOR JUGO VIDAL FOR EXPENSES INCURRED BY HIM WHILE TRAVELING ON OFFICIAL BUSINESS.
title.vi: Đạo luật ủy quyền cho Chính phủ Tỉnh Capiz chi khoản tiền chín mươi tư đô la Mỹ và chín mươi xu, tiền tệ địa phương, để hoàn lại chi phí mà Thống đốc Jugo Vidal đã chi khi đi công tác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้รัฐบาลจังหวัดกาปิซจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวนเก้าสิบสี่ดอลลาร์สหรัฐและเก้าสิบเซ็นต์สกุลเงินท้องถิ่นเพื่อชดเชยค่าใช้จ่ายของผู้ว่าราชการจูโก วิดัลที่เกิดขึ้นระหว่างการเดินทางปฏิบัติหน้าที่ราชการ
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pemberian Wewenang kepada Pemerintah Provinsi Capiz untuk Mengalokasikan Jumlah Sembilan Puluh Empat Dolar Amerika Serikat dan Sembilan Puluh Sen, Mata Uang Lokal, guna Mengganti Biaya yang Dikeluarkan oleh Gubernur Jugo Vidal Selama Perjalanan Dinas
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa kepada Kerajaan Wilayah Capiz untuk memperuntukkan jumlah sembilan puluh empat dolar Amerika Syarikat dan sembilan puluh sen, mata wang tempatan, bagi menampung perbelanjaan yang ditanggung oleh Gabenor Jugo Vidal semasa melancong atas urusan rasmi

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Capiz is hereby authorized to appropriate from provincial
funds the sum of ninety-four dollars and ninety cents, local currency, to reimburse Governor Jugo Vidal, of
the Province of Capiz, for expenses incurred by him, including the expenses of such assistants and constables
as accompanied him on a trip of inspection through the Province of Capiz in January, nineteen hundred and

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 3, 1903.
